entries.candidate: Meta (Runways Information Services Limited) Clonee Data Centre, Clonee, Co. Meath (EPA IE licence P1192-01): new site, existing operations
entries.reason: Meta's Clonee Data Centre info sheet (local_data/country-research-uk-devolved-ie-p4/ops/meta-clonee-info-sheet, served from wp-content/uploads/2026/09/Meta_s-Clonee-Data-Center.pdf via the asset link whose sitemap lastmod is 4 September 2026; PDF created 2 September 2026) says in the present tense that the Clonee Data Centre is part of Meta's global infrastructure, lists 300+ operational jobs, EUR 1.4bn investment in Meath and on-site water-efficiency measures. But the sheet is undated and no Internet Archive copy of it exists (CDX: none for the PDF; the asset redirect's last copy is 10 July 2026, pointing to an older file), so its publication day is not bounded by a second dated source. Meta's Europe page (version modified 4 September 2026; Internet Archive copies only from February and May 2026) gives '300+ operational jobs supported once completed' for Clonee, which does not state current operation. The latest LEAP items on P1192-01 are incident records posted on 29 July 2026, outside the window.
entries.reopen_condition: A dated Meta, EPA or licensee statement of the Clonee campus's operation within 85 days (an AER, noise survey, site-visit report, or an operator page whose modification is bounded by an archived copy), then admit a new site with the EPA P1192-01 register site-centre grid reference (register of 9 October 2023) transformed from Irish Grid, screened against SDC-EN Meath I at Bracetown (1.56 km).

entries.candidate: Microsoft Dublin Data Center Campus: completion of DUB15 (P1187-01 installation)
entries.reason: The P1187-01 addition records operation of the licensed installation as of 31 August 2026. The 2025 AER (posted 30 April 2026) says DUB15 was in phased deployment and commissioning with the remainder of its site under construction, and only 10 of 22 gas engines were operational in 2025; no in-window record of DUB15's full completion was found.
entries.reopen_condition: A later dated Microsoft or EPA record that DUB15 (or its gas plant) is complete or fully operational; record it as a newer status of the same project without implying more than the record states.

entries.candidate: Northern Ireland data-centre planning applications and NIEA permits (sweep)
entries.reason: No Northern Ireland record exists in the Atlas and no candidate was found. The NI planning register (planningregister.planningsystemni.gov.uk) renders applications only through its search pages (simple, advanced, list and map search), which were not used, and its /_next assets are robots-disallowed; DfI and DAERA robots.txt disallow PDF, XLS and XLSX files, which is how DAERA's MCP and PPC registers and EIR responses (including DAERA/26-438 of 31 July 2026 on data centres' water use) are published; the DfI regionally significant developments topic page names no data-centre case. OpenDataNI's robots.txt returned HTTP 500.
entries.reopen_condition: A permitted listing of NI planning decisions or notices (council weekly lists in HTML, Planning Appeals Commission decisions, DfI notices) naming a data-centre development with a site location, or an operator statement for an NI facility with an official locator.
